source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For straightforward accumulation into the same string, prefer value += suffix to value = value + suffix. D212003 explicitly requested it for readability. The accepted current getUsageText keeps it for separators and translated usages. This is a proposed syntax preference for the same simple pattern. It does not decide whether a larger formatter should use arrays/join or templates.
title: Use += for straightforward string accumulation in getUsageText
